summary: Gateway Security settings include allowing admins to set insecure passwords, Gateway basic auth enabled (disabling blocks local-user basic auth, and all UI access if only local auth exists), gateway token header name, access token expiration, the JWT private key (rotating it breaks current sessions), social auth username as full email, and CSRF trusted origins for reverse proxies.
